decisions.reason: A custom earmold close to the established hearing-care offer costs little to keep in the firm's digital production. Its prospects are still unresolved after one year with only a website mention, so the option is worth more than its carrying cost.

The EARsleeve has its own page and fits the firm's custom earmold workflow for universal in-ear hearing systems. Carrying cost is low and its value is still unfolding, so keeping the option is justified.

The thermoforming unit extends the firm's established dental equipment line and is featured on its own page. There is no evidence yet that its value won't be realized, and keeping it costs little relative to its upside.
